content.title: TNPDCL seeks nod to procure 3,000 MW
content.caption: TNPDCL increases power procurement from 1,500 MW to 3,000 MW through a medium-term tender agreement.

slides.heading: TNPDCL seeks nod to procure 3,000 MW
slides.text: TNPDCL increases power procurement from 1,500 MW to 3,000 MW through a medium-term tender agreement.

slides.heading: Relevant context
slides.text: TNPDCL, which submitted the proposal to procure 1,500 MW to the Tamil Nadu Electricity Regulatory Commission (TNERC) in February this year, has now doubled the quantum.

slides.heading: Important details
slides.text: The estimated cost of the medium-term procurement is around ₹5.50 per kilo watt per hour, with the annual expenditure pegged at ₹6,150 crore.
